gotchas: Custom domain, not *.myshopify.com — the shopify platform recipe's own notes flag a detect regression on custom-domain stores; on this run detect worked fine (script[src*=cdn.shopify.com] etc. matched, cart and checkout reached normally).

Add to cart via the /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink, then /cart, then the visible checkout button (button[name="checkout"] / #cart-drawer-checkout-button — which one renders varies by entry path). A direct goto to /checkout can 302/abort depending on cart state; going through the cart page's own button is the reliable path.

Card surface is the split card-fields iframes (iframe[name*="card-fields-number"] / -expiry / -verification / -name); all four mounted and the name/expiry frames accepted pressSequentially. Number/CVV were not attempted with a real value in this run (see note).
